research_notes: The eventual user-facing recommendation should include confidence qualifiers tied to evidence count rather than generic certainty language.
For example, observed lower bound, candidate boundary, validated cap with N clean runs, and profile coverage are independently reportable.
This makes future updates straightforward as new evidence arrives.
It also prevents one successful stress run from being overgeneralized.
The current 14m retry can at most contribute one strict clean observation if it closes successfully.
